description: Provision of pre-primary education at ISCED level 0 (early childhood education designed to support children's early cognitive, physical, social and emotional development). Administration, inspection or support of educational institutions providing pre-primary education.
includes: administration, inspection, operation or support of schools and other institutions providing pre-primary education
scholarships, grants, loans and allowances to support pupils pursuing pre-primary education
excludes: primary education (ISCED-2011 level 1) — classified together with pre-primary in this group; see also 0912 if separately tracked
child care outside an educational programme is part of social protection (1040)
